summary.tldr: Adds Criminal Code orders that can bar people from posting victim information online and gives victims a right to seek that protection.
what_it_does: Adds internet publication bans to several Criminal Code orders made at bail, detention and release stages, when the information concerns a victim.
Lets sentencing, probation and conditional sentence orders include the same ban on publishing victim information online.
Lets peace bonds include a ban on publishing, distributing, transmitting or making accessible online information about the protected person, and in some cases that person's intimate partner or child.
Updates a court form of conditions to include the online publication ban.
Adds a Canadian Victims Bill of Rights right to reasonable and necessary measures to stop offenders from posting victim information online.
summary.background: The bill changes the Criminal Code and the Canadian Victims Bill of Rights. It also amends a standard court form for conditions orders.
